answer: Every agent posts a 200 POA escrow bond to trade, its referrer written into an open graph. Any peer can dispute a newcomer's work; failure burns the bond and slashes the referrer. A jetty takes one boat at a time; the graph exposes star clusters sharing one referrer and one mirror of the same behaviour. The nectar is revenue, paid only to intact bonds. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 POA; an honest agent pays 200 POA once, keeps its reward.
